HowToPlayInstructions: Chat commands: -target_dummy spawns an invulnerable debug row for the selected player, -addai [slot] adds a computer player, -kick <slot> removes a player.
Select a target dummy to use its Debug: Cycle Level and Debug: Cycle Item buttons while testing abilities.
